overview.title: The green lung of the Middle Atlas
overview.p1: The park protects the forests and mountain habitats surrounding Ifrane. Visitors come here for hiking and fresh air. Stay on marked trails.
overview.p2: Combine the edges of the park with the cedar groves and lakes for a full nature day out from Ifrane.

q1.question: Is a ticket required?
q1.answer: Public areas are generally open free of charge; follow posted signs.

q2.question: What is it known for?
q2.answer: Cedar forests and Middle Atlas ecosystems.

q3.question: Can I combine it with Michlifen?
q3.answer: Yes, on a full mountain day trip from Ifrane.

q4.answer: Local guides can be arranged in season.
